title: bromus hordeaceus subsp. mediterraneus
intro: Bromus hordeaceus subsp. mediterraneus, commonly known as Mediterranean brome or soft brome, is a subspecies of grass native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Europe. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant effects. The therapeutic actions of Bromus hordeaceus subsp. mediterraneus include its ability to stimulate the appetite, alleviate coughs, and soothe digestive issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
